allowedZones.externalSource: Reference to credential source outside repository and run bundle, scoped access; never copy into evidence.
allowedZones.isolatedMemory: Bounded runtime credential memory only with lifecycle/zero-persistence and crash/dump proof; browser tmpfs not pre-approved.

encodingLimits: Planned auditor coverage: raw UTF-8; standard/URL base64 padded and unpadded; upper/lower percent UTF-8; JSON escapes including unicode escapes. Nested encodings, compression, binary DB and transport transforms need explicit bounded decoding inventory in W5/N; no universal encoding detection claimed. W3 executes no auditor.

publicationPolicy: Stop/quarantine owned mode on match or missing/unreadable sink. No public export of new leaking artifact. Preserve restricted historical evidence in place; do not erase leaks or rotate real credentials as a W3 side effect. Missing/N/A applicability proof blocks; no required sink silently skipped.
